posts.en:
dsh-input-traffic is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with freeze/resume and in-place multi-line editing.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c6e45855fde5f0e26791.html
